Ingredients:  - Russet Potatoes  - Heavy Cream - Colby Jack Cheese - Seasonings for taste (in step list)  - Sharp Cheddar Cheese  - Unsalted Butter  - Vegetable Oil - Broccoli (optional for filling) - Aluminum Foil - Garlic Paste  - Sour Cream - EVOO - Cubed Chicken (cut up breasts or tenderloin)  [Baked Potato] * 1st you want to prep your potatoes. Bake in the oven at 400 degrees F for about an hour. * Once potatoes are soft and cooked completely remove the foil and cut down the middle of each potato, hot dog style. Scoop out the inside of the potato and put into an empty mixing bowl. To the mixing bowl you're going to add 1 stick of unsalted melted butter, tbsp of garlic paste, parsley, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp garlic salt, cooked broccoli, 1/2c grated sharp cheddar cheese, pepper, and 2 tbsp sour cream. Mix together and scoop filling back into potatoes. [Sauce]  * Add 1 tbsp butter to pan, 1 tsp garlic paste and parsley and melt down. Add about 1cup of heavy cream and let cook for 5 minutes to thicken. Add pepper, onion powder and lawrys seasoning salt to season. Add colby jack cheese (about 1cup) and mix until sauce is thick and consistency you like. [Chicken]  * I used chicken beasts and cut into cubes. Add EVOO and seasoned with parsley, onion powder, garlic powder and adobo. Strawberry Nutella Brownies 🍓🤎 Perfect brownies for summer!  (recipe makes an 8x8 pan) Ingredients:  10 tbsp (140g) unsalted butter, melted 1 cup (200g) granulated sugar ¼ cup (50g) brown sugar, packed  2 eggs, room temp 1 tsp vanilla extract ½ cup + 2 tbsp (56g) unsweetened cocoa powder ½ tsp salt 1 tbsp (13g) vegetable oil ½ cup (63g) all purpose flour, spooned & leveled or weighed (don’t pack it in) ¾ cup chocolate chips 190g (~⅔ cup) Nutella  Topping: Strawberry slices, patted dry (as many as you want/enough to cover the top) Nutella (to spread over the top & drizzle)  Instructions: Line an 8x8 pan with parchment paper. Spread the nutella onto the parchment into a thin, even square the size of the pan. Freeze for at least 30 minutes or until frozen solid. Preheat oven to 325°F and line/grease an 8x8 pan with parchment. In a large bowl, whisk melted butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla, then whisk vigorously for 1-2 minutes. Stir in cocoa powder and salt until fully combined. Mix in oil, then gently fold in the flour until just combined (don’t over mix). Fold in chocolate chips. Spread half the batter into the greased pan. Place the frozen nutella sheet on top of it. Then, spread the remaining batter over it to cover the nutella layer completely. Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick near the center comes out with no wet batter. It should just come out with a little nutella & slightly moist crumbs. Let the brownies cool completely. Spread a thin layer of nutella over the cooled brownies, add strawberry slices (patted dry) all over the top, and drizzle with more nutella.  Best enjoyed fresh!  #bakingrecipe #brownies #chocolatestrawberries #nutella #recipe

videos.caption: Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wraps🍗🧀🌯 The flavours are absolutely phenomenal, one of the best wraps made using a sheet pan. Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Slice chicken breast and thighs into cubes. Add seasonings with grated parmesan cheese and drizzle of olive oil. Mix until well coated. 2. In a pan on low heat, add light butter with seasonings. Toast for a minute before adding evaporated milk, extra Parmesan and cream cheese. Stir till smooth and creamy. 3. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper, spread marinated chicken evenly (do not overcrowd), add light layer of cooking spray then bake in a preheated oven for 20-22 mins at 200C until crispy. 4. While chicken is still hot, add extra parmesan and parsley. Mix well until coated and extra cheesy. 5. Assemble the wraps with shredded lettuce, onion, tomato, crispy chicken and sauce. ENJOY! Storage and Reheating Tips - Store chicken and creamy sauce in separate containers in the fridge. - When ready to eat, just warm up chicken in oven/air fryer for 4-5 mins 180C / 370F. 🧅🥓 Bacon-Wrapped Stuffed Onions These Bacon-Wrapped Stuffed Onions are loaded with seasoned ground beef and gooey melted cheese, wrapped in crispy bacon, and grilled or baked until beautifully caramelized. A delicious low-carb comfort food that's perfect for BBQs and family dinners! 🥩 Ingredients 4 large yellow or sweet onions 1½ lbs ground beef 8–12 slices bacon 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese ½ cup shredded mozzarella cheese 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon onion powder 1 teaspoon smoked paprika 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce ½ teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon black pepper ½ cup BBQ sauce 1 tablespoon olive oil 👩‍🍳 Instructions Prepare the onions: Peel the onions and carefully cut off the tops and bottoms. Remove the inner layers, leaving about 2–3 layers to create sturdy onion shells. Prepare the filling: In a bowl, combine the ground beef, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, Italian seasoning, Worcestershire sauce, salt, and black pepper. Mix until well combined. Add the cheese: Mix the shredded cheddar and mozzarella into the seasoned beef. Stuff the onions: Carefully fill each onion shell with the beef and cheese mixture. Press gently so the filling is packed inside. Wrap with bacon: Wrap each stuffed onion with bacon, overlapping the slices slightly. Secure with toothpicks if needed. Add BBQ sauce: Brush each bacon-wrapped onion generously with BBQ sauce. Bake or grill: Oven: Preheat to 375°F (190°C). Place the onions on a foil-lined baking tray and bake for 45–60 minutes, turning or brushing with more BBQ sauce halfway through. Grill: Cook over indirect medium heat for approximately 45–60 minutes, keeping the lid closed as much as possible. Finish until crispy: Brush with another layer of BBQ sauce during the final 10 minutes and cook until the bacon is crisp and the beef reaches a safe internal temperature of 160°F (71°C). Rest and serve: Let the stuffed onions rest for 5–10 minutes, then carefully remove any toothpicks and serve hot. 🔥 Tips Use large onions so there's plenty of room for the filling. Don't pack the beef too tightly or it may take longer to cook. For extra smoky flavor, use smoked cheddar or add a little chipotle seasoning. Add cooked bacon bits to the beef mixture for an extra bacon boost. A meat thermometer is the best way to confirm the beef is fully cooked. 🍽️ Serving Ideas Serve these with grilled vegetables, coleslaw, baked potatoes, a fresh salad, or roasted broccoli.
